title: Timing and size of the upwelling-season chlorophyll maximum
query: Using the supplied CMEMS biogeochemical reanalysis monthly chlorophyll and nitrate for 1993-2020 off California and Oregon (30-48 N, 130-116 W), determine how the timing and magnitude of the coastal upwelling-season chlorophyll maximum differ between the northern and southern California Current System and from year to year, and what controls them.
